Historical teams. Hypothetical matches.

Choose club seasons from the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, or national-team editions from the men's World Cup, Euros and Copa América since 2010. Club years refer to the season-ending year: Manchester City 2023 means 2022/23, not the calendar year. National teams use their tournament edition.

Where the strengths come from

Real scoring and conceding totals are normalized against the competition's scoring environment, with an eight-match average-team prior to reduce small-sample extremes. A neutral 1.35-goal baseline combines one team's attack with the other's defense. Home advantage is optional. Rates are capped between 0.15 and 4.5 goals per side. Cross-league and club-versus-country comparisons assume equal competition strength; they are experimental, not calibrated forecasts.

What is simulated

A seeded generator samples shots, shot quality, goals and passes. Historical squad snapshots and their recorded coaches are shown in the builder. A suggested XI is selected by positional availability and can be edited. Simulated actions are assigned to eligible selected players using position-based heuristic weights, not historical player ratings. The engine does not reconstruct an actual match, injury situation or manager's tactics. Missing rosters retain anonymous event units. The same team editions, venue, model version and seed reproduce the same events. A new seed produces a new possible match. Matches finish at 90 minutes; extra time and penalties are not simulated.
